pitch: Personalised Indian diet plans made by qualified dietitians, with a recipe for every dish, for weight loss, weight gain, PCOS, diabetes, thyroid, BP and more.

services.name: Free consultation call
services.details: 15-minute call with a dietitian to understand your goal and suggest the right plan.

services.name: 1-month diet plan
services.details: Weekly personalised diet charts (veg / non-veg / Jain / vegan), recipes, WhatsApp support and weekly check-ins.

services.name: 3-month transformation plan
services.details: Everything in the 1-month plan plus progress tracking, plan changes every week and priority support. Most popular.

services.name: Medical diet plan
services.details: For diabetes, PCOS, thyroid, BP, heart, fatty liver and kidney conditions, made around your reports.

faqs.q: Do I need to buy special food?
faqs.a: No. Plans use regular home-cooked Indian food from your own kitchen.
Yes, everything works on WhatsApp and calls, anywhere in India or abroad.

faqs.q: How fast will I see results?
faqs.a: Most clients see visible change in 3–4 weeks when they follow the plan. We never promise unsafe or guaranteed weight loss.
The 3-month plan can be paid monthly. Ask the team for details.

offer: Book your free consultation this week and get 10% off any plan.
